preflight: Validates account IDs (not zero, not self-preauth).
preflight: Calls credentials::checkArray for credentials arrays.
checkExtraFeatures: Ensures credentials fields are only allowed if featureCredentials is enabled.

preclaim: For credentials arrays, checks issuer existence and uniqueness.

test_coverage_notes: DepositPreauth is typically tested in unit/integration tests under the transaction processing suite, e.g., 'test/tx/DepositPreauth_test.cpp' or similar. Tests likely cover: valid/invalid field combinations, self-preauth, zero account, credentials array size/structure, feature gating, and ledger state checks (duplicate, missing entries). Gaps may exist for edge cases in credentials array validation (e.g., duplicate issuers, malformed elements), and for feature gating if featureCredentials is toggled. Tests for checkExtraFeatures may be indirect unless feature toggling is explicitly tested.

validates: Exactly one of the four fields (sfAuthorize, sfUnauthorize, sfAuthorizeCredentials, sfUnauthorizeCredentials) must be present
If sfAuthorize or sfUnauthorize is present, the value must be a valid (non-zero) AccountID
An account cannot preauthorize itself (sfAuthorize must not equal sfAccount)
